method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP), rerun on the full US-listed market (StockAnalysis / S&P Global screener, Oct 6, 2026 close). A stock qualifies if it has: market cap of $10B or more and at least a year of trading history; TTM revenue growth of 15% or more that analysts expect to continue (consensus revenue growth of 8%+ next fiscal year and 8%+ a year over the next 3 years); a positive forward P/E of 35 or less and a PEG of 1.5 or less where available; a Buy or Strong Buy consensus from 5+ analysts with 15%+ upside to the average target; beta of 2.6 or less; share count up no more than 20% in a year (screens out stock-funded mergers); and at least $20M a day of trading volume. The 12 picks stay as long as they keep qualifying, and the ranked bench (best-first by a GARP score: revenue growth 35, PEG or forward P/E 25, upside 25, rating 15; at most two names per industry) refills any card you dismiss. Speculative, pre-profit and very high-beta names are left to the Risk It tab.
dataNotes: Price, market cap, forward P/E, PEG, consensus rating, analyst count and average price target come from each company's StockAnalysis.com statistics page (S&P Global Market Intelligence) as of the Oct 6, 2026 close; TTM revenue growth and its period come from the StockAnalysis revenue page (where a fiscal year just ended, TTM equals that fiscal year). Screen inputs (3-year and next-year revenue forecasts, beta, share change, volume) come from the StockAnalysis screener. 78 US-listed stocks passed the screen today; all 12 picks still qualify, and the bench holds the next 18 by score. 'n/a' means the figure was not available.
